references.text: The actual answer to the question of how the eyes were opened, given by the healed man: 'A man named Jesus made mud, applied it to my eyes and said: Go to Siloam and wash yourself.' This is the direct clarification of the question in verse 10.
The Pharisees ask the same question to the newly healed man: 'How did he receive his sight?' This repeats the question from verse 10 and shows the continuing wonder at the miracle.

The healed man draws a conclusion based on the question of how the miracle happened: 'Since the beginning of time, it has never been heard that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.' This underscores the uniqueness of the event addressed by the question in verse 10.
The introduction to the account where the disciples ask Jesus about the cause of blindness leads directly to the miracle that the question in verse 10 concerns.
